frozen_clause.effects: Return process capabilities/schema without opening repository.
frozen_clause.failure_retry: Invalid request or unknown operation rejects before repository effects.

guard_effect_retry_source_assessment: Run calls CheckRequest and canonical.Clone before its capabilities/schema branches, and both branches return before openStore. CheckRequest resolves the closed RequestSchema and validates it; unknown operations/keys fail before repository opening.

Current capabilities adds versioned operation/retirement/progress metadata, as authorized by NT-03; it does not move either branch behind repository opening or enable a backend. Schema returns the selected owned schema. This preserves the finite admission/effect boundary rather than claiming every payload field is unchanged.

frozen_clause.effects: Open root-anchored filesystem and operation-local memo.
frozen_clause.failure_retry: Unsupported platform/unsafe root refuse.

guard_effect_retry_source_assessment: After the repository-free branches, Run calls openStore(root), returns its error immediately and registers defer f.Close only after success. Production openStore is store.Open. Linux Open anchors an existing real directory with O_DIRECTORY/O_NOFOLLOW/O_CLOEXEC; portable Open checks a real directory and resolved root path before os.OpenRoot. Both successful constructors allocate newMemo per FS.

Build-selected fs_other.Open always returns UNSUPPORTED_PLATFORM. Its bounded message now derives the declared backends and explicitly distinguishes source capability from release qualification (NT-08); no unsupported platform is opened. Unsafe roots refuse UNSAFE_ROOT. No OS runtime result is inferred from this source inspection.

frozen_clause.guard: operation in sharedObservation, or read mode exact
frozen_clause.effects: Acquire shared lock for selected read operations. Windows observation requires existing store metadata; Linux needs none. Darwin lock path may create store.lock.
frozen_clause.failure_retry: Busy: bounded 2s retry then LOCK_TIMEOUT; fresh read advised. Missing Windows metadata: NO_LOCAL_STORE.

guard_effect_retry_source_assessment: sharedObservation uses the exact explicit allowlist and read mode exact; default/other modes are exclusive. Run passes a two-second timeout. Windows uses ObservationLock with existing-only metadata/read access, distinct missing metadata NO_LOCAL_STORE and lock failure/timeout. Linux shared flock uses the repository descriptor without metadata. Darwin calls its ordinary lockFile path, which may initialize metadata.

Lock failure returns before dispatch or transaction work. Busy backends use nonblocking acquire/retry until their bounded deadline then LOCK_TIMEOUT with fresh-read advice. These are source semantics, not a hard wall-clock bound on all OS calls.

retained_observations.limits: Windows branch TESTED; Linux no-metadata and Darwin lock-file behavior remain unexecuted/pending, not inferred from this row.

frozen_clause.effects: Acquire exclusive lock; index remains exclusive despite being observational. Windows index uses read-access ObservationLock.
frozen_clause.failure_retry: LOCK_FAILED / LOCK_TIMEOUT; no semantic mutation.

guard_effect_retry_source_assessment: All non-shared operations default to exclusive locking; index is not on the shared allowlist. Windows explicitly routes index through ObservationLock(exclusive=true), preserving existing-only read access while taking an exclusive mutex. Other supported platforms use f.Lock(exclusive=true).

Acquisition errors return before request hash/Engine creation/Pending/dispatch and make no semantic mutation. LOCK_FAILED/LOCK_TIMEOUT remain distinct; permitted lock metadata creation is not canonical artifact content.

retained_observations.limits: Windows exclusive admission only; no Darwin/Linux runtime claim or arbitrary LOCK_FAILED injection claim.

frozen_clause.effects: Initialize platform lock metadata only; report created or present. Linux reports present.
frozen_clause.failure_retry: Native filesystem failures remain explicit.

guard_effect_retry_source_assessment: Run branches init-store after successful Open and before generic dispatch. initStore checks LockMetadataPresent, acquires ordinary writer Lock(true,2s), immediately unlocks, and returns present/created from pre-acquisition metadata. Linux metadata is intrinsically present. Native errors return unchanged; the outer deferred Close remains registered.
This initializes platform lock metadata only; it does not write a canonical document, create a transaction, or claim installation/release initialization.

retained_observations.limits: Windows actual created/present; Linux present-only and Darwin effects remain pending; not an installed-host initialization proof.

frozen_clause.guard: operation is not recovery or successful replay
frozen_clause.effects: Refuse normal canonical reads and writes until deliberate recovery.
frozen_clause.failure_retry: RECOVERY_REQUIRED; use existing transaction ID, not blind new mutation ID.

guard_effect_retry_source_assessment: After lock/request hashing, recover deliberately branches before Pending. Journaled mutations perform Lookup first; a successful committed replay returns the stored outcome. A pending same-ID replay refuses RECOVERY_REQUIRED. All remaining operations check Pending and return RECOVERY_REQUIRED before canonical dispatch if prepared journals exist.
Recovery and same-ID recorded state govern safe retry. This barrier does not promise rollback, bypass with a fresh ID, or masking a corrupt/unreadable journal as absence.

retained_observations.limits: Original controlled Windows/amd64 native execution only; no Linux/Darwin backend effects, installed production cohort, visible parent, provider or release claim.

frozen_clause.effects: Unlock and close filesystem; discard per-operation memo.
frozen_clause.failure_retry: No daemon or persistent in-memory coordinator.

guard_effect_retry_source_assessment: After successful Open, Run defers Close; after successful acquisition it defers unlock. LIFO releases the mutex before closing the FS on return/error/recoverable unwinding. init-store immediately unlocks its own successful lock. Failed acquisition has no acquired-unlock obligation.

Each Run constructs a local Engine and fresh FS memo; no daemon/global memo is assigned. The lifetime claim is reachability within the operation, not synchronous erasure of an externally retained FS pointer, os.Exit handling, or process-death cleanup.

limits: Existing runtime tests exercise successful return and subsequent operations, lock exclusion/retry and bounded per-operation reuse; no named test directly observes every deferred close on every error branch.

frozen_clause.guard: valid id/hash, <=512 safe disjoint edits, exact before bytes, no pending journal
frozen_clause.effects: Write synced before-images and destination stages; create directories as needed; retain request hash and result.
frozen_clause.failure_retry: Prepublication errors clean temporary stages/backups when safe; no target changes.

guard_effect_retry_source_assessment: Commit, under its owning engine lock and valid canonical request hash, validates the safe operation ID, existing Lookup/Pending state, 1..512 edits, safe portable disjoint paths, valid before/after shape and exact current before bytes before staging. It creates needed transaction/history/target directories and synced createOrCompare before-images and destination stages, retaining request hash/result in the prepared journal.

Until journal publication is durable, deferred cleanup best-effort removes only recorded stage/backup paths. Errors preserve canonical targets; existing unexpected partial journal stages require explicit reconciliation. This does not claim metadata-directory rollback or successful cleanup despite arbitrary I/O failure.

retained_observations.limits: Windows two-target creation/replacement/CAS and named injected I/O tested; numeric512 limit and every collision permutation are inspected source clauses, not claimed as separately executed test cases; no power-loss guarantee.

frozen_clause.effects: Durably publish full write intent before touching canonical targets.
frozen_clause.failure_retry: Publication uncertainty returns COMMIT_OUTCOME_UNKNOWN and preserves recovery material.

guard_effect_retry_source_assessment: Commit marshals complete prepared intent/result, creates/syncs a non-authoritative .next and create-only publishes the final .json before canonical target effects. Pending and Recover recognize only authoritative journal names.

Publication failure may occur after publication/unlink/sync; durable=true prevents deleting recovery material and returns COMMIT_OUTCOME_UNKNOWN with the original operation ID. No blind new-ID resubmission is advised.

retained_observations.limits: Process death is real Windows subprocess exit; not hardware power interruption, arbitrary disk/fsync failure, or other OS backend qualification.

frozen_clause.guard: current target still equals its before hash
frozen_clause.effects: Replace/create/delete targets sequentially; may expose partial files only behind recovery block.
frozen_clause.failure_retry: Any failure after publication returns COMMIT_OUTCOME_UNKNOWN; do not assume no change.

guard_effect_retry_source_assessment: After publication Commit rereads each target and compares its before hash, then sequentially removes/replaces/creates the corresponding target. A postpublication read, digest mismatch, replacement or injected failure returns the original outcome plus COMMIT_OUTCOME_UNKNOWN.

Partial canonical effects can exist behind the prepared Pending barrier and are reconciled through deliberate recovery; an error is not proof of no change or a transaction-wide atomic filesystem replacement.

retained_observations.limits: Windows actual create-pair replacement sequence; external concurrent after-journal digest race rejection is source-inspected, not independently injected in this retained case.

frozen_clause.effects: Persist committed journal including original result and before-image references.
frozen_clause.failure_retry: Final acknowledgement write failure is outcome unknown; inspect/replay same operation ID.

guard_effect_retry_source_assessment: Only after every target replacement succeeds does Commit mark the retained journal committed, marshal it and updateMetadata including original result/before-image references. Final write or after-complete error remains outcome unknown with the original operation ID.
No failure acknowledgement is interpreted as rollback; same-ID inspection/replay is authoritative for recovery.

retained_observations.limits: Lost-response/durable outcome exercised via controlled injection; no independent arbitrary disk acknowledgement failure claim.

frozen_clause.effects: Return stored original outcome with replay=true; no new revision, no repeated effect.
frozen_clause.failure_retry: Old journals without result require refresh_required, not fabricated latest identity.

guard_effect_retry_source_assessment: Lookup reads and validates the recorded journal, compares the request hash, rejects prepared/rolled_back states, then constructs outcome(j,true) from the committed record. Commit/Run return this before new staging/effects. mutationResult copies the original stored result; a legacy result-less journal emits refresh_required rather than inventing latest identity.
Exact replay preserves original revision/outcome without another effect. Legacy refresh fallback is source-inspected, not claimed as a separately observed hosted case.

retained_observations.limits: Replay executed; result-less legacy journal refresh_required fallback inspected at source, not executed by this selector.

frozen_clause.effects: Refuse operation-id reuse.
frozen_clause.failure_retry: OPERATION_ID_REUSE; new logical intent needs new ID.

guard_effect_retry_source_assessment: Lookup compares request_sha256 before any terminal-state replay and returns OPERATION_ID_REUSE on mismatch. Commit returns that error before Pending/staging and engine returns it before canonical dispatch. A new logical intent requires a new identity.

retained_observations.limits: Original controlled Windows/amd64 native execution only; no Linux/Darwin backend effects, installed production cohort, visible parent, provider or release claim.

frozen_clause.effects: Refuse ordinary replay pending recovery.
frozen_clause.failure_retry: RECOVERY_REQUIRED.

guard_effect_retry_source_assessment: Lookup returns RECOVERY_REQUIRED with the original ID for a matching prepared journal, before outcome construction or a repeated effect. Run also retains the global Pending barrier for other ordinary operations. Explicit recovery is the exit from this state.

retained_observations.limits: Original controlled Windows/amd64 native execution only; no Linux/Darwin backend effects, installed production cohort, visible parent, provider or release claim.

frozen_clause.effects: Refuse resurrecting rolled-back write.
frozen_clause.failure_retry: OPERATION_ROLLED_BACK; inspect then explicitly choose new operation.

guard_effect_retry_source_assessment: Lookup returns OPERATION_ROLLED_BACK for a matching terminal rollback; Commit and Run propagate it rather than resurrecting the write. The engine also rejects a noncommitted replay defensively. The operator inspects current identity and explicitly chooses a new operation for new intent.

retained_observations.limits: Original controlled Windows/amd64 native execution only; no Linux/Darwin backend effects, installed production cohort, visible parent, provider or release claim.

frozen_clause.guard: hash matches path; complete checks passed
frozen_clause.effects: Record positive validation and optionally copied bytes within 64MiB; failures/missing never cached.
frozen_clause.failure_retry: Budget exhaustion merely causes reread; no behavior downgrade.

guard_effect_retry_source_assessment: Memo keys validated values by kind/full hash. Hash-checked root-relative ReadRecorded only records a successful read; KeepRaw independently requires bytes hashing to the ref basename and clones retained bytes. Validation/chain markers are added only after the owning schema/link checks pass. Failed/missing/mismatched reads do not create trusted reuse.

The operation raw budget is 64MiB; excess recording simply returns without caching, so a later read reopens and validates. Returned raw bytes are cloned; no behavior or schema downgrade follows budget exhaustion. A raw-byte cache entry is not itself a schema/whole-chain validity marker.

frozen_clause.guard: same kind/full hash; appropriate memo view
frozen_clause.effects: Reuse validated evidence; scan view still reads its own bytes and sees only validation marker.
frozen_clause.failure_retry: Cannot seed whole-chain validity through arbitrary reader data.

guard_effect_retry_source_assessment: Held requires the exact kind/full-hash key; Scan exposes only validation markers, disables Raw/KeepRaw/KeepValue and still invokes its own supplied reader. Observation and receipt readers recheck bytes against expected hashes even when skipping repeated schema validation.

InspectMemo for arbitrary readers passes trusted=false and never marks receipt-chains; only store-backed Inspect may reuse a whole repository chain. reuseReceipt requires the chain marker and recorded copied receipt/event bytes. Snapshot scan still obtains its own bytes and rejects absent/invalid objects.

frozen_clause.effects: No cross-operation trust/cache survives.
frozen_clause.failure_retry: Completion normalized cache only valid if no intervening output/catalog write in same operation.

guard_effect_retry_source_assessment: Open allocates a fresh memo per handle; Run closes its operation-local FS and does not publish that handle to another operation. completionWorkspaces keeps derived snapshots only after two identical successful passes. completionWorkspaceKey distinguishes roots/identity/normalized mode; reuse returns a canonical clone.

Normalized reuse assumes no intervening catalog/internal-output write; reusing completion checks run before publication, while operations needing a fresh check use the non-reusing API. This is an explicit call-graph condition, not automatic invalidation on arbitrary writes or synchronous memory erasure.

limits: Operation ownership/lifetime source contract only; Close does not promise synchronous erasure of an externally retained FS pointer. No timing/memory-retention or cross-process runtime claim.

frozen_clause.effects: Run semantic operation once; may commit before response serialization.
frozen_clause.failure_retry: Structured error on invalid request.

guard_effect_retry_source_assessment: CLI parses the bounded request through canonical.Read, requiring a JSON object, then calls operations.Run exactly once. The canonical parser rejects duplicate keys, trailing JSON, invalid Unicode and unsupported numeric shapes; Run checks the closed request schema/operation before repository effects.
Errors return structured public JSON fault/stderr/exit class; valid operations may already commit before success-envelope encoding. No acknowledgement or error is a general rollback guarantee.

frozen_clause.effects: Build JSON stdout result.
frozen_clause.failure_retry: RESPONSE_TOO_LARGE after Run may occur after side effect; do not infer no commit from error.

guard_effect_retry_source_assessment: After operations.Run succeeds, CLI marshals the success envelope and checks encoded length plus newline against the default65536 or request budget before stdout success write. RESPONSE_TOO_LARGE therefore can follow a completed mutation.
Same-ID journal/recovery state remains authoritative. No named retained fixture directly exercises oversized post-Run success, especially after mutation; this is finite source conformance only.

limits: No named runtime fixture covers a successful Run whose final encoded envelope exceeds the wrapper budget, especially after a mutation. Source ordering establishes the limited no-rollback contract, not a local execution observation.

frozen_clause.failure_retry: Write failure exits5; same operation ID/recovery state is authority for uncertain acknowledgement.

guard_effect_retry_source_assessment: After successful encoding/budget admission, CLI writes the success envelope plus newline once. A returned write error exits5. Successful writing proceeds to exit0 (or validation exit2). No rollback is performed or claimed.

The contract assumes a conforming io.Writer and recovery/operation identity for uncertain acknowledgement. The separate public-fault best-effort writer is not this success branch. No retained direct stdout-error fixture is claimed.

Fatal process termination and a second reporting-writer panic are outside this handler contract. No retained direct injected-panic fixture is claimed.
